svg.text: Six in ten major-award wins went to Drama
756 wins across the 8 major Oscars, 1928–2025, grouped by each winning film's genre.
756 wins across Best Picture, Directing, the four acting awards and both screenplay awards.
Other = the seven less-common genres (Western, War, Music, Horror, Mystery, Fantasy, Science Fiction).
Drama's share of major-award wins, by decade
Drama wins ÷ all major-award wins in the decade. Dashed line = 50%.
Best Picture winners by genre, year by year
98 winners, one dot per year. Each row is a decade, read left to right from year 0 to year 9.
Source: AMPAS Awards Database (via DLu/oscar_data) · genre = first-listed TMDB genre of the winning film · 8 major awards, 1928–2025
